# Veqtor Workspace

> Veqtor Workspace connects an AI assistant to saved documents on a Mac. It lets the assistant read, edit, comment and save files according to the user's instructions.

## Product

- [Overview](https://veqtor.pro/): the current Workspace product and visual examples.
- [What it does](https://veqtor.pro/product): document reading, editing, comments and saving.
- [How it works](https://veqtor.pro/how-it-works): identify files, describe the task, save and review.
- [Installation](https://veqtor.pro/setup): Workspace 0.1.2 for macOS on Apple Silicon. Download the Claude Desktop extension; it manages Python and dependencies. The ChatGPT Desktop installer prepares the local connection automatically; it is unsigned and requires an extra macOS permission. Codex CLI and IDE can use the manual connection.
- [ChatGPT Desktop installer](https://github.com/JohnDeer-ai/veqtor-workspace/releases/download/v0.1.2/veqtor-workspace-0.1.2-chatgpt-macos-arm64.dmg): Mac M1 or newer, macOS 13+. Not signed with Developer ID or notarized by Apple. See the installation guide for the macOS permission step.
- [Mac extension](https://github.com/JohnDeer-ai/veqtor-workspace/releases/download/v0.1.2/veqtor-workspace-0.1.2-macos-arm64.mcpb): installer for Claude Desktop on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or newer); this installer does not support Intel Macs.
- [Source code](https://github.com/JohnDeer-ai/veqtor-workspace): public repository, Apache-2.0 license, release notes and issue tracker.
- [Documentation](https://veqtor.pro/docs): four MCP tools: workspace_info, document_task, run_python and check_docx.
- [Security](https://veqtor.pro/security): local task copies, model-provider processing and saving boundaries.
- [Limitations](https://veqtor.pro/limitations): macOS, document compatibility, explicit tracked changes and Word review.

Workspace has no embedded model or hosted account service. The assistant chooses the editing method. Tracked changes must be requested; they are not the default. Document checks are optional, not a save gate or a guarantee of correctness. The local Python runner has no network access, but the assistant can be online and document content returned to it enters the AI conversation. Save checks see on-disk changes, not unsaved Word edits. Avoid simultaneous editing and reopen the saved result in Word.

## Earlier product

- [Veqtor MCP 0.5.0](https://veqtor.pro/veqtor-mcp): the earlier, separately published fourteen-tool MCP product and its original download and documentation. It is not the Workspace installer.
- [Historical video](https://veqtor.pro/demo): a recording of Veqtor MCP v0.1.2, not Workspace.
